newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Congolese PM starts visit to Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Congolese PM starts visit to Morocco.

text.p: Congolese Prime Minister David Charles Ganao arrived on Monday in Morocco on a 48-hour official visit, the official MAP news agency said.
Ganao, who is accompanied by a seven-minister delegation, is expected to confer with King Hassan on the Western Sahara issue on Tuesday, a diplomatic source said.
Congo has recently cut its ties with the self-styled Saharan Arab Democratic Republic (SADR).
Polisario, the military arm of the SADR, fought Morocco for nearly 17 years to get the independence of the Western Sahara before a ceasefire under U.N. supervision went into force in September 1991.
Congo was among 70 countries which recognised the SADR.
